# NeuromorphicHardwareCoDesign

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The joint optimization of spiking neural network algorithms and underlying hardware (e.g., memristive crossbars or FPGA) to maximize energy efficiency and throughput. Bridges TCC's dark silicon challenges with iNEST's neuromorphic requirements, enabling scalable, low-power manycore architectures.
